Head of Product — Consumer Credit, London hybrid.

Haven Credit (London, 90 people, Series B) is a consumer-credit lender with personal loans and a new credit card. We're hiring a Head of Product to lead three PMs and own the lending and card roadmap, reporting to the CEO. Hybrid, two days a week in London. Requirements: a minimum of 12 years of product management experience, of which at least five leading product teams in lending — this is a firm requirement set by our board, not a guideline.
